title: Weigh Feeder
model_title: Belt Weigh Feeder (Gravimetric, Load Cell + Speed Sensor)

introduction.definition: A weigh feeder (gravimetric belt feeder) is a short belt conveyor that measures and controls the mass flow of material. Load cells under a weigh idler measure the belt load per metre; a speed sensor measures belt speed. The controller multiplies the two to get the flow rate (kg/s) and adjusts belt speed to hold the set-point.
applications: Feeding raw meal, coal and additives to kilns and mills
Blending in cement, minerals and chemicals
Proportioning ingredients in food and plastics processes
key_points: Needs regular zero and span calibration
introduction.summary: A belt weigh feeder delivers a set mass flow (kg/h). A load cell under a weigh idler measures belt loading (kg/m) and a speed sensor measures belt speed; the controller multiplies them and adjusts belt speed to hold the set rate.

foundation: Support on steelwork or a concrete plinth designed for the hopper/bin load on the feeder plus impact and dynamic loads.
Isolate vibrating machines from the structure with their springs/rubber mounts — never weld or rigidly bolt the vibrating body to the structure.
alignment: Install the weigh idler and approach idlers in line (laser) — misalignment causes belt-tension errors.
Protect the weigh section from wind, dust build-up and skirt friction.
piping: Chutes and skirts: allow a gap that widens in the direction of travel so material does not jam; fit dust seals and connect dust extraction where required.
Leave clear access for liner change and for the hopper shut-off gate.
commissioning: Run empty first: check direction, amplitude/speed, temperatures and noise.
Load gradually, check the material bed is even and the discharge rate matches the set-point; record motor current as a baseline.

routine.task: Clean the belt and weigh area; check belt tracking.

periodic.task: Zero calibration and test-weight span check.

overhaul.task: Material (drop) test against a reference scale; replace belt and idlers.

lubrication: Pulley bearings and gearmotor: lubricate to schedule.

causes: Build-up on weigh idler, belt tension change, wind

safety: Lock out before cleaning; use guards at pulleys (nip points).

video_tutorials.title: Weigh Feeder — Maintenance

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Weigh Feeder.
Clean the belt and weigh area; check belt tracking.
Zero calibration and test-weight span check.
Material (drop) test against a reference scale; replace belt and idlers.
Watch for weighing drift: rate disagrees with stock reconciliation. Common cause: build-up on weigh idler, belt tension change, wind.
Watch for belt mistracking: belt runs off, edge wear. Common cause: pulley misalignment, material build-up.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
